title: Parse a quoted CSV record
prompt: Implement parseCsvRow in src/csv.js. It parses one CSV record into fields, supports commas inside quoted fields and escaped quotes written as two quotes, and preserves spaces inside and outside fields. A quote may only begin an empty field. After a closing quote, only a comma or end of input is valid. Throw SyntaxError for an unclosed quote or an invalid quote in an unquoted field. Keep the existing export.
